answer: For outpatient community-acquired pneumonia in healthy adults, amoxicillin or doxycycline is recommended according to the guidelines from ATS/IDSA (Treatment of Community-Acquired Pneumonia, 2023) [ATS/IDSA, 2023]. These antibiotics are suitable for uncomplicated cases and would not require further adjunctive therapy. Please verify with a healthcare provider as every patient's case may vary.

results.content: For outpatient community-acquired pneumonia in healthy adults, amoxicillin or doxycycline is recommended. For inpatients, beta-lactam plus macrolide combination therapy is standard.
